contour.tips_method: Within x609..720 of registered source, pick the strongest 7-row-averaged luminance drop vs 3px Gaussian neighborhood. This is a visibility check for the fine tips, not a strand count. Low values can be skin texture.
contour.measurement: Input units are original pixels, x to the right, y down. Three-pixel horizontal support and a five-row median on the guide. Dense / loose denote 24 and 12 luminance levels below local backdrop; skin also uses R-G>15. For y<260, game edge is the end of connected pixels darker than the local terrain median by 23 levels or skin-colored, before four consecutive background pixels. This includes an exposed translucent dark hair card but does not misclassify the stronger inner skin/card contrast as the silhouette. At y>=260 use the skin/background transition; scored points are independently checked on edge.jpg. Ref y0 is a crop, not a missing scalp measurement.

hair_flow.grid: 35 x 35 patches; 7 x 6 stagger-free sample centers; reference tensor coherence >= .45 and 90th percentile luma <= 75 in all three registered images. Orientation is undirected in [0,180).

temple_fibers.view: 2560x1440 native 88-degree shrine camera. Reference image aligned first by eye and mouth corners. Crops and lower-face sampling then anchored to the separate lobe bottom of each source.
temple_fibers.measurement: Nine-pixel direction-supported troughs measured relative to local skin in D65 CIELAB L*. A visible match exceeds 2 L* in at least three out of four consecutive probes, spaced 4 native pixels apart. The last supported position is an optical corridor endpoint; overlapping fibers cannot always be identified individually. Counts refer to screen-space crossings.

units_and_uncertainty.coordinates: Source pixels at 2560x1440. The art is registered at native screenshot scale. Each signed distance is measured vertically from its own earlobe, positive downward.
units_and_uncertainty.threshold_sensitivity: Each lane includes its deepest supported distance using thresholds 1.5 / 2.0 / 2.5 L*. These are sensitivity checks, not statistical confidence intervals. The art trace stops at the inspected crop limit.

first_pass_revision_56.observed_endpoint_definition: The endpoint dictionary refers to 2 L* optical crossings located along the projected geometry.

ear_helix_check.view: same native shrine profile; 8 manually identified locations along bare outer helix, each 11x11 pixel median.

lower_companion_comparison_57_58.units: Native image pixels in 2560x1440 shrine profile. Positive x points toward face. Only pair optical ridge samples when both shots pass 2 CIELAB L*.

capture_registration.method: Template correspondence of pupil and mouth corner; independent ear-lobe registration checked with a star earring and outer pinna. Baseline is the actual revision 55 capture; the revision 58 raw frame is shifted +4 px in x, 0 in y. Ear-adjacent revision 58 features are approximately +7,+1 relative to revision 57.

temple_fibers.control_interpretation: High-frequency control values are rms gray levels after a 1.3-pixel Gaussian high pass, with the two real captures registered to their symmetric halfway frame. Lower contrast in the earring, lashes and lower wisp of this revision 58 capture precludes assigning the entire optical length difference to fiber geometry. The wide-field ridge sweep uses a larger region than the manually traced art lock.

recording.candidate: SilkReed / HaitangPortrait58 / actual camera-stepped native Unreal viewport PNGs
recording.field_of_view_note: 58 is a sequence of real renders at controlled angles; 30fps is the viewing cadence and does not measure real-time game performance.

58_core_per_frame_low_resolution_change.note: Every file is unique. The small angular step near the turning point naturally produces small adjacent differences.

recording.time_domain: Source55 includes the playing character idle animation. For 58 the character pose is held and the engine camera advances by its assigned angle after settling each step.
